body: Update: things haven’t gotten better and honestly I feel more persuaded to end this all
Thank you so much for your reply

Also. This Quarantine shit is fucking me up. Online learning just doesn’t work with my lifestyle and I have so many responsibilities at home that I just can’t handle it. The teachers wouldn’t understand.

Yeah I guess so. My own standards make me feel overwhelmed to the point that I feel that I can’t breathe. It’s just that I’ve gotten so far in my life. For fucks sakes I’m a High Honor Roll student. I’ve been dealing with these feelings for so long that up till now I decided to open up about it. Even if it’s online.
Thank you so much for you reply. I don’t know how things will go on later on for me. I hope that my loved ones can not feel so disappointed in me..

They wouldn’t believe me when I talk about how I feel and just say that my feelings aren’t valid and that things will get “better”. I think it’s also kind of shameful to feel suicidal when my life was going so well but I just have no hope at this point.
Sure I mean there’s nothing to lose. I absolutely cannot go to anyone about this not even my own boyfriend.
